messages:

Subject: Request demo — BrightVox exploring inference savings

We just completed a self-serve signup and scheduled a demo for Aug 12 at 11:00 PT via your public booking link (confirmation ref #BV-451). Looking forward to seeing the cost/latency tradeoffs for our ingestion-heavy pipeline.

Attendees from BrightVox: Sara Chen (data platform lead), Tom Alvarez (infra).

Please confirm and share any prep materials.

Thanks,
Sara

Cc: sales@redwood.ai

Hi Sara — welcome and thanks for signing up. I own the inbound SDR queue for your region and I took the liberty of adding a short discovery call before the demo so we can tailor the session to your latency/cost goals.

Proposed: Aug 12, 10:15 PT (15m) discovery, then demo at 11:00 PT. If that works I will send an updated invite with a quick pre-demo checklist.

Vivek — per routing I see this as qualifying inbound; if you want to own the demo handoff let me know and I can transfer the calendar event.

Cheers,
Avery

SDR, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Cc: Sara Chen <sara.chen@brightvox.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request demo — BrightVox exploring inference savings

Avery — thanks for the heads up. I spoke with Sara on LinkedIn earlier this week (they named me as the main contact), and I had already started building a PoV plan for BrightVox. Given that, I will own the demo and lead the conversation on architecture and cost modeling.

Marissa / Karthik — can Sales Ops confirm whether this lead was routed to the inbound SDR queue automatically or if it should have been assigned to me as the named account owner? If it's a routing bug we should fix the calendar ownership to avoid duplicate invites.

Sara — happy to own this. I'll coordinate with Avery for the discovery if you prefer a joint call. Sending a short prep doc now.

Best,
Vivek
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 08:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request demo — BrightVox exploring inference savings

Quick ops note: the self-serve booking came through as an anonymous inbound (no HubSpot owner) and hit the SDR queue by rule #12 (region: NA, channel: self-serve). However, Vivek's account ownership was added to HubSpot on Aug 8 when Sara replied to a LinkedIn message — that update did not trigger a re-assignment for existing bookings.

I can reassign the calendar and HubSpot owner, but want sign-off from Sales leadership. Marissa — do you want us to transfer calendar events for inbound bookings when an account owner exists? If yes I will patch the workflow.

Also attaching a one-pager (MAP brief) to share with BrightVox before the demo.

[Attachment: MAP-Brief.pdf (PDF, 250KB)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Sara Chen <sara.chen@brightvox.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request demo — BrightVox exploring inference savings

Team — good catch, Karthik. For fairness to SDRs and to keep SLAs intact, here's the directive: if a self-serve booking lands in the SDR queue and an Account Exec has been designated for the account prior to the booking time, transfer calendar ownership to the AE automatically and notify the SDR within 2 business hours.

Avery — I'll let you join as co-host for the discovery to lean on your qualifying notes. Vivek — please make sure you add the lead owner field in HubSpot (and paste the HubSpot record URL in replies) after the transfer. Karthik — please implement the workflow change and set the notification.

Sara — we moved the calendar invite to Vivek as primary host and attached a short prep doc. Looking forward to the call. If the new time is awkward, suggest an alternative and we'll adapt.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Agenda (10 minutes prep + demo):
- 10:15 PT: quick discovery (key data volumes, current infra, SLOs) — Avery joins to capture qualification.
- 11:00 PT: 45m demo (architecture + cost modeling + next steps).

Prep: please have a sample 1-hour tokenized workload estimate and a list of current GPU types.

Attachments: [MAP-Brief.pdf], [meeting.ics] (invite sent).

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/98372/company/brightvox (I've set myself as owner).

If anything changes, reply here and we'll adjust. Looking forward to it.

Best,
